description: A chain of forks: the original O (6 records) continued after the fork, its fork B (4) and B's fork G (5) share the first two records, and B and G share B's first own record. Keepers resolve largest-first across all three: O keeps the shared prefix, G keeps B's first own record plus its own turns, B keeps only its last record. Pairwise best overlap made G a keeper of the prefix O already holds (double count). The smallest transcript has the smallest id, so taking sessions in id or scan order instead of size order also fails.
